children: Polymarket’s submarket for the Counter-Strike match between FUT Esports and Lynn Vision in the BLAST Open Porto B Group saw the "Over" option in the O/U 2.5 maps market surge from 44% one hour earlier to 84%, a 40-point swing. title: Polymarket Counter-Strike Match Market Sees Over 2.5 Odds Jump to 84%
